That gives a total of about 185 g.

For energy, egg white is about 50 kcal per 100 g, so 125 g comes to about 65 kcal. The orange mash at about 150 kcal per 100 g adds roughly 90 kcal. That comes to about 155 kcal, but if some of the white pieces are actually cheese, the figure would be higher. I'll estimate 220 kcal.
